errors.evidence: The description states that there is no strict quantitative order, but the bars are clearly arranged in ascending order based on their percentage values (10.8%, 15.8%, 31.7%).
The phrase 'са достатъчно ясни' (are sufficiently clear) is a subjective evaluation of the labels' quality, which constitutes interpretation and is not a neutral, objective description.

The phrase 'етикетите на стълбовете' (the labels of the bars) is ambiguous. It is unclear whether it refers to the numerical data labels on top of the bars (e.g., 10.8%) or the categorical labels on the x-axis below the bars. The context suggests the latter, but the phrasing is imprecise.
